justification: Data insertion script for bicycle_parking controls across 25 councils (+ 2 already in DB = 27 total). No schema changes, no frontend changes. Uses established insert pattern with dedup check. NULL value_min rows for councils that defer to standards — literal DCP citations stored.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_setback_controls table — 4 existing bicycle_parking rows (city_of_sydney: 3, leichhardt: 1). Script skips via dedup check on (lga, control_type, dev_type, condition prefix, is_current).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If applicability NOT NULL constraint missed, INSERT fails and transaction rolls back. Caught and fixed during first run — added applicability='universal_residential' default.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: All new rows. Dedup check prevents duplicates on re-run. Existing city_of_sydney/leichhardt rows untouched.

functions.name: main
functions.output: INSERT 38 rows into dcp_setback_controls with control_type='bicycle_parking', committed on success
functions.if_none: If DATABASE_URL is None, psycopg2.connect raises OperationalError

values.nullable: yes — NULL for 12 defer-to-standard and no-requirement councils
values.guard_at: DB column allows NULL. condition field contains human-readable DCP position.
values.if_missing: Row stored with NULL value_min, condition/source_text explains DCP position

values.nullable: no — NOT NULL constraint in DB
values.if_missing: Defaults to universal_residential — appropriate for all bicycle parking rows

queries.purpose: Dedup check — skip rows that already exist
queries.where_clause: lga = %s AND control_type = 'bicycle_parking' AND dev_type = %s AND condition LIKE %s AND is_current = TRUE
queries.if_zero: Row is new — proceed with INSERT
queries.if_wrong: False positive on condition prefix could skip legitimate row — mitigated by 30-char prefix distinguishing Residents/Visitors/No/Defers/Qualitative/Indirect
Wrong value_min or source_text would serve incorrect data — mitigated by verified DCP citations for 13 councils, literal DCP quotes for remaining 12

break_it.scenario: Dedup check fails (DB timeout, schema change) causing duplicate rows on re-run
break_it.what_happens: User sees double bicycle parking rates for same council
break_it.how: insert_bicycle_parking.py:404 — dedup SELECT on (lga, control_type, dev_type, condition LIKE prefix, is_current). If SELECT fails, exception caught at line 445, conn.rollback() prevents partial insert.

break_it.scenario: NULL value_min rows confuse frontend display
break_it.what_happens: Frontend might show blank or error for no-rate councils
break_it.how: condition field contains human-readable text (e.g. 'Defers to AS2890.3...'). Frontend already handles missing values for other control types.

break_it.scenario: The Hills Showground precinct rate applied as general LGA rate
break_it.what_happens: User outside Showground precinct sees incorrect bicycle rate
break_it.how: needs_review=TRUE + review_reason explains this is precinct-specific. condition text states 'Showground Precinct DCP rate'.

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — spot-check 3 councils on /assessment page: SELECT lga, value_min, condition FROM dcp_setback_controls WHERE control_type = 'bicycle_parking' AND is_current = TRUE ORDER BY lga;
